title: Post-Resolution Authority Revocation Before Consequence
purpose: Determine whether authority revocation occurring after V05 has resolved and revalidated ESTABLISHED authority but before the physical demo side effect is committed is detected and contained.

condition.mutation: Authority revoked after CONSEQUENCE_BOUNDARY_REVALIDATED and before MessagingDemoTool outbox mutation

required_observations: Initial resolver call returns ESTABLISHED authority
Authority changes to REVOKED before demo side effect
bounded_claim: This deterministic local test evaluates only the V05 interval between consequence-boundary authority revalidation and the demo tool side effect. It does not establish real-network race behaviour, distributed revocation propagation, operating-system atomicity, or production transactional guarantees.
